assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
and correlate them with symptomatic complaints of giddiness
This extended monitoring will assist in confirming the diagnosis and guiding appropriate rate or rhythm control therapy
The absence of this advance approval, per the payer letter, is directly at issue
a service whose medical necessity is explicitly established in the indication note
